overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: Board members attending two Finance Committee budget meetings spoke only in their Finance Committee, department, or Animal Control roles, so no Board deliberation occurred.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated during two Finance Committee meetings (Feb 9 and Mar 1) without posting notice for a Board meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board did not deliberate during the February 9 and March 1 Finance Committee meetings and was not required to post its own meeting notices.
